title: How to Cancel Xbox Game Pass — Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel Xbox Game Pass Ultimate, Core, or PC subscription. Stop the monthly charge through your Microsoft account. Keep purchased games.
intro: Xbox Game Pass is managed through your Microsoft account. Cancellation is straightforward — you keep any games purchased at the member discount, but lose access to the Game Pass library.

steps.title: Go to Microsoft Services page
steps.text: Visit account.microsoft.com/services and sign in with your Microsoft account. Find Xbox Game Pass in your subscriptions list.

steps.title: Click "Manage" next to Game Pass
steps.text: Click "Manage" on your Game Pass subscription (Ultimate, Core, or PC Game Pass).

steps.title: Click "Cancel" or turn off recurring billing
steps.text: Choose to cancel the subscription or turn off recurring billing. Your access continues until the end of your paid period.
steps.tip: If you have months of prepaid time stacked up, turning off recurring billing is better than immediate cancellation — you keep all prepaid time.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.text: Confirm your choice. Game Pass library access ends when your current period expires. Games purchased at member discounts remain yours.
steps.tip: Save data for any cloud-saved games before your subscription ends, in case cloud saves become inaccessible.

warnings: All Game Pass library games become unplayable after cancellation. Only games you purchased outright remain accessible.
If you redeemed a Game Pass code (e.g., from a promotion), turning off auto-renewal still lets you use the full prepaid period.
Xbox Live Gold features (online multiplayer) may require Xbox Game Pass Core after cancellation.
Cloud gaming (streaming) stops working without Game Pass Ultimate.

faqs.q: Will I lose my game saves?
faqs.a: For games you own: saves are fine. For Game Pass-only games: cloud saves are preserved for some time. If you re-subscribe, they should still be there.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund for Game Pass?
faqs.a: Microsoft offers refunds within 14 days for digital subscriptions, provided you haven't used significant time. Contact Xbox support for requests.

faqs.q: What games can I still play after canceling?
faqs.a: Only games you purchased (bought outright, including those bought at Game Pass member discounts) remain playable. The entire Game Pass catalog library becomes locked.

faqs.q: Can I play online multiplayer without Game Pass?
faqs.a: Free-to-play games (Fortnite, Warzone, Apex) don't require any subscription. For paid games, you need at least Xbox Game Pass Core for online multiplayer.

refund.details: Microsoft offers refunds within 14 days of purchase. Contact Xbox support at support.xbox.com. After 14 days, refunds are at Microsoft's discretion.

retentionTactics: Microsoft may offer a discounted month or show games being added to the library soon.
They may suggest converting to a cheaper tier (PC Game Pass instead of Ultimate).
